items.description: md2LLM enables fine-tuning of open-source language models using personal Markdown files. It includes an observability and management layer for the fine-tuning process, allowing users to generate training data, manage models, and track and store each state of the fine-tuned model.

Weaviate enables efficient vector similarity search, which is crucial for building effective RAG systems. Additionally, we use local language model (LLM) and embedding models.
